speaker: Narrator
text: Before the armies and the challenge, David watched his father's sheep in the hills of Bethlehem.

speaker: David
text: Easy, little one. There is water here. Stay close to the flock.

speaker: Messenger
text: David! Jesse, your father, sends you to your brothers. Take this grain and these loaves to the camp, and the cheeses to their commander. Bring word of how your brothers are.

speaker: Messenger
text: I will watch the sheep. Your father is counting on you.

speaker: David
text: Keep them near the water. I will take the provisions and bring my father news.

speaker: Narrator
text: David left the flock with a keeper and set out for the valley of Elah. Beyond the quiet hills, two armies faced one another.

speaker: David
text: The camp is beyond that ridge. I can hear the soldiers. I must find my brothers.
